envelope.description: Implement activity leases, restart recovery and fallback scheduling

body.title: Implement activity leases, restart recovery and fallback scheduling
body.summary: Keep executor-owned activity distinct from the fixed 60-second fallback scheduler and reclaim stale observation capacity.
acceptanceChecks: Verify 30-second owner renewal and 120-second expiry without observers, including multiple tasks in one conversation, selective release, and stale callbacks. Readers cannot renew owner activity.

Recover the last verified committed snapshot, preserve the first bounded owner-loss deadline across restarts and fence old epochs. After expiry release active capacity and retain an explicit bounded unknown observation when capacity allows. Never infer a terminal execution result or relaunch work.

Keep one opted-in scheduler per stable task. Verify anchored 60-second slots, 120-second scheduler lease expiry, disconnect and handoff, in-flight fencing, no catch-up burst, and separate terminal shutdown.

tests.name: Verify monotonic 60-second fallback, transfer, suspension and unchanged suppression
Verify 30-second owner renewal and 120-second expiry with no observers, separate tasks in one chat, removal, and stale callbacks
Fence scheduler claim, renew, release, duplicate slots and late replies across transfer with deterministic 60-second cadence and 120-second expiry
Restart repeatedly without owners, preserve the recovery deadline, release expired reservations and refuse stale revalidation without inventing termination
